tools.name: list_room_skill_files
tools.title: List Room Skill Files
tools.description: List the files in the SEMOSS 'room' skill, the platform's guidance for working with playground rooms, the persistent named conversations that carry chat history, a selected model, a system prompt, and MCP tool configuration. Call this when the user asks about creating/listing/renaming/pinning/deleting rooms, reading or updating room options (model, system prompt, temperature, attached MCPs), reading chat history, or binding an insight to a room, and when they name CreatePlaygroundRoom, GetPlaygroundRooms, GetWorkspaceRooms, RenameRoom, PinRoom, RemoveUserRoom, SetRoomForInsight, GetRoomOptions, UpdateRoomOptions, GetPlaygroundMessages, AskCOTRoom, or COTRoomResult. Returns each file with its path, name, and description so you can read only what you need; start with SKILL.md. Not for plain LLM completions (see the model skill) or document ingestion (see the vector skill).

project.title: project
project.description: The room skill (room). Always this value.

tools.name: read_room_skill_file
tools.title: Read Room Skill File
tools.description: Read one file from the SEMOSS 'room' skill in full, for writing code that manages playground rooms or threads messages through one. Pass filePath exactly as list_room_skill_files reports it; SKILL.md is the main guide and covers the create-then-ask flow, why SetRoomForInsight must run once per session before LLM turns, the full room lifecycle, reading and updating room options, and pulling message history.

filePath.title: filePath
filePath.description: Path of the file to read, relative to the skill folder, as reported by list_room_skill_files. Use 'SKILL.md' for the main guide.
